findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were dirty dishes observed in the basin of the handwashing sink. The dishes were removed and placed inside of the ware washing sink to correct the violation. Ensure that the handwashing sink remains unobstructed to allow easy access for employees to wash hands.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were raw beef patties stored above ready to eat foods inside of the main cooler. The RTE foods included veggies, sauces, and cheeses. Discussed with the PIC and the beef was moved to the bottom shelf of the cooler to correct the violation. Ensure that raw meats are always stored beneath RTE foods to protect against contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a wastewater leak from the plumbing under the hand sink. The PIC was informed and was able to tighten the plumbing and repair the leak during the inspection. Ensure plumbing is tightened and monitored after moving the truck to avoid wastewater spills.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed to don gloves without washing their hands. CORRECTED- The employee and PIC were educated that proper handwashing needs to be done prior to putting gloves on. Ensure that employees are following the proper handwashing procedure prior to putting gloves on.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The water to the mobile unit was not plugged in and water was not accessible at the sinks at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- The PIC plugged the pump in and stated that it is usually plugged in, but that he had to move the truck. The PIC was educated that the mobile unit cannot operate without running water and that the pump ALWAYS needs to be plugged in.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There was not a sanitizer bucket made at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- A Chlorine sanitizer bucket was made and tested at the correct concentration of 100ppm. The PIC was educated that there must always be ready-to-use sanitizer during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: The PIC stated that he drains his waste water in the storm drains or at a restaurant in New Berlin. CORRECTED- The PIC was educated that waste water needs to be drained at an approved sewage drainage facility. Ensure that waste water is properly disposed of.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: The preparation cooler was observed to be holding at 70F (cut tomatoes). CORRECTED- The prep cooler was unplugged and the PIC plugged it back in. The prep cooler lowered to under 41F and the food had only been in there for around 30 minutes. Ensure food is kept at 41F or below if it is a TCS food.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The PIC was using a Quaternary ammonium sanitizer spray bottle (a premade solution) but only had Chlorine test strips. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC and he stated that he will cease using the Quat sanitizer and use the Clorox bleach they have on the mobile unit. Ensure that there are always test strips available for all types of sanitizers that are being used.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: REPEAT- The floor is observed to not be caulked to the wall and trim. Ensure that this is caulked/sealed to the wall and trim. This was discussed with the PIC. Physical facilities should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
